neighbours.label: The word right before an idiomatic closing 'all' ('of them [all]', 'one size fits [all]', 'rule them [all]', 'mother of [all]'): the output direction promotes ' all', ' them', ' ever'
fire: Everyone agreed she was the wisest of them all.
This ancient oak is the tallest of them all.
There is no one size fits all plan for retirement.
A single standard to rule them all has never existed in this field.
Grandfather was the kindest of us all.
The big one, the daddy of them all, comes next spring.
Fans call it the mother of all road trips.
Consultants sell a one size fits all solution to every bank.
quiet: Everyone agreed she was the wisest of the sisters.
This ancient oak is the tallest in the park.
There is no simple plan for retirement in this country.
A single king came to rule the land and his reign was short.
Grandfather was the kindest man in the village.
The big one, the largest of the storms, comes next spring.
Fans call her the mother of three small boys.
Consultants sell a custom solution to every bank.

notes: Card: ' of' x7, ' fits' x3, ' than' x3, ' them' x2; logit effect promotes ' all', ' them', ' alike'. Probe: 'fairest of them' 1.31, 'fits' 0.74-0.96, ' rule' 0.80, 'greatest of them' 0.70, 'father of us' 0.64, 'mother of' 0.37; 'First of all' and 'After all' 0.01 (the all itself does nothing), 'Her shoe size fits' 0.09, 'She is the mother of' 0.01.
